turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes, of course. With he, she and it, we add -s to the verb. I play. She plays.

Your turn: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. Write only the verb.
